title: Model-agnostic information transfer and fusion for classification with label noise
abstract: arXiv:2604.25845v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Label noise presents a fundamental challenge in modern machine learning, especially when large-scale datasets are generated via automated processes. An increasingly common and important data paradigm, particularly in domains like medical imaging, involves learning from a large dataset with coarse, noisy labels supplemented by a small, expert-verified, clean dataset. This setting constitutes a typical information transfer and fusion problem. However, the significant distribution shift between the noisy and clean data violates the core overall parametric similarity assumptions of existing statistical transfer learning methods, while their reliance on parametric models is ill-suited for complex data like images. To address these limitations, this paper develops a generic model-agnostic nonparametric framework for classification with label noise, which applies to a broad class of classifiers. translated_title: 面向标签噪声分类的模型无关信息迁移与融合
translated_abstract: 标签噪声是现代机器学习中一个根本性的挑战，尤其是当大规模数据集通过自动化过程生成时。一种日益普遍且重要的数据范式，特别是在医学成像等领域，涉及从一个带有粗糙、噪声标签的大型数据集进行学习，并辅以一个小型的、经过专家验证的干净数据集。这一设定构成了一个典型的信息迁移与融合问题。然而，噪声数据与干净数据之间显著的分布偏移违背了现有统计迁移学习方法所依赖的核心总体参数相似性假设，同时它们对参数化模型的依赖也使其不适用于图像等复杂数据。为解决这些局限性，本文开发了一个通用的模型无关非参数框架，用于带标签噪声的分类，该框架适用于广泛的分类器类别。我们的方法利用小型的干净数据集……
tldr: 本文提出了一个通用的模型无关非参数信息迁移与融合框架，用于带标签噪声的分类问题，克服了现有统计迁移学习方法因噪声与干净数据间分布偏移及参数化模型限制所带来的不足，并可广泛应用于各类分类器。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a generic model-agnostic nonparametric framework for information transfer and fusion in classification with label noise, overcoming the limitations of existing statistical transfer learning methods caused by distribution shift between noisy and clean data and their reliance on parametric models, while being applicable to a broad class of classifiers.
